Haru is an original sample character by Live2D Inc. It is not Taolinghu / 桃铃狐.
No character artwork or model geometry has been changed. Model manifest references to unused sample voice, display info and user data were removed. The original sample voice recordings are not bundled or played.

Taolinghu original project model (v0.15.0)
----------------------------------------
Character reference: web/assets/taolinghu-hd.png in this repository.
New layered artwork generated for this project with ImageGen; source components,
PSD, editable model project and authoring records: art/taolinghu-live2d/.
The Taolinghu geometry, ear/tail/arm controls and interaction curves are newly
authored for this project and do not reuse the Haru mesh or texture.
Compiled with PSD2Live v3.6.7 (build-time only, not bundled):
https://github.com/tsunehimatoi/psd2live/releases/tag/v3.6.7
No additional runtime library is introduced. Cubism Core / Framework licenses
above continue to apply. This repository has not declared an open-source license.
